race.description: The Don Moore Memorial Race (Bm58) Hcp
race.comment: MISSION OF JOY (9) goes on top after a decisive 4L maiden win at the Sunny Coast and a nose second to Drinkwater in a CL1 at Eagle Farm, when doing her best work late. Splits suggest the rise in trip will suit her third-up. ODIN'S MOUNT (4) is the danger after winning well at Warwick then missing by just over half a length at this track despite late interference. Is open to further improvement third-up and gets an important 3kg claim to offset the big weight. TRANSGRESS (5) has been freshened with 35 days after going down in a CL3 at Lismore. His win prior at the same venue lines up well though, so he may be worth another look. SIR MAURICE (1) is honest, proven at this venue and gets a claim. No reason he won't be there at the business end.
